title: September invoice is missing the VAT line

articles.subject: September invoice is missing the VAT line
articles.body:
Hello,

The invoice we received this morning shows a total but no VAT specification. Our auditor requires the VAT amount and rate to be stated separately.

Could you send a corrected invoice?

Kind regards,
Gustav Ebbe
Director, Ebbahus Stiftelse
gustav.ebbe@ebbahus.se
